data.description:
## Summary

For hot same-slot sessions, restore before saving to prevent overwriting a valid restore candidate. Zero GPU footprint change.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. Hot session restore executes before save when same slot is involved
2. No increase in save/restore timeout failures
3. Measurable restore-rate improvement for hot sessions
4. Zero change to GPU footprint or save timeout parameters

## Key Files

- proxy/proxy/session.py (save/restore ordering logic)
- proxy/proxy/slot_scheduler.py (slot state tracking)

## Deliverables

- Code changes in session.py for restore-before-save ordering
- Hot session detection logic
- No new dependencies or config changes

## Dependencies

- None

## Notes

- Impact: ~438K prefill-tokens/day (hot session reuse)
- Ordering fix, zero GPU footprint change
- Recovers same-slot reuse without new saves
- Must verify no regressions in timeout behavior
data.title: Fix: Restore-before-save ordering for hot same-slot sessions
